title: Well-posedness and mean-field limit estimate of a consensus-based algorithm for min-max problems
summary: The recent work arXiv:2407.17373 proposes a derivative-free consensus-based particle method that computes global solutions to nonconvex-nonconcave min-max problems and establishes global exponential convergence in the sense of the mean-field law. This paper aims to address the theoretical gaps in arXiv:2407.17373, specifically by providing a quantitative estimate of the mean-field limit with respect to the number of particles, as well as establishing the well-posedness of both the finite particle model and the corresponding mean-field dynamics.
